component.name: Publii
component.summary: The most intuitive Static Site CMS designed for SEO-optimized and privacy-focused websites.

description.p: Creating a website doesn't have to be complicated or expensive. With the Publii app, the most intuitive CMS for static sites, you can create a beautiful, safe, and privacy-friendly website quickly and easily; perfect for anyone who wants a fast, secure website in a flash.
Unofficial, work in progress, rudimentary, experimental and probably unstable Flatpak build for Publii - in other words, use it if you know you can handle errors.
